P.name: Voracity
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will reduce the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Katarina's''' {{tip|abilities}} by 15 seconds.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Sinister Steel:}} Whenever '''Katarina''' retrieves a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}, she slashes around herself to deal {{pplevel|68;72;77;82;89;96;103;112;121;131;142;154;166;180;194;208;224;240;257;275<!--|formula=???-->|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{pp|key=%|70 to 100 for 4|1 to 16}} AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects to enemy champions hit, and reduce ''{{ai|Shunpo|Katarina|Shunpo's}}'' '''current''' cooldown by {{pp|key=%|78 to 96 for 4|1 to 16}} of its '''total''' cooldown.
P.description4: {{as|Daggers|buzzword}} grant {{tip|sight}} of their radius and will disappear after being on the ground for 4 seconds.

Q.name: Bouncing Blade
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' throws a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. Upon arrival, the {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} also bounces to up to two additional {{tip|sight|visible}} nearby enemies, dealing the same damage and travelling to bounce targets over {{fd|0.15}} seconds each time.
Q.description2: The {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} lands {{rutngt|1}} after striking the first target, {{tt|about 350 units|slightly random location}} opposite from their position when it struck them.

W.name: Preparation
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' tosses a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} into the air above her current location and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays until it lands after {{fd|1.25}} seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} for the same duration.

E.name: Shunpo
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' {{tip|blinks}} to a target location near the unit or {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} closest to the cursor, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the nearest enemy in range and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
E.description2: '''Katarina''' prioritizes blinking to the location near {{as|Daggers|buzzword}}, then enemy champions, then enemy non-champions, and then any other unit.

R.name: Death Lotus
R.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds, rapidly throwing a dagger every {{fd|0.166}} seconds to up to 3 of the closest nearby enemy champions, {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself in the process.

Each dagger deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced in effectiveness, and inflicts {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} on the target for 3 seconds.
R.description2: ''An enemy champion within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 500 units is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''
